challenge.better_approach: Considered: have the verdict gate read the plan's chart instead of the berth. That would undo berths as the record of truth. Or retire old berths on redraft, but berths are never edited (memory old-chart-berths-still-judged). Refusing at the draft door is the smallest change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That no caller relies on draft-without-chart over a standing berth. Measured: in cairn, sail.py draft has no caller but CC's hand. The only proof calling draft is the sail proof, on a ticket with no berth.
challenge.prior_art: akienasus_cc_0 fixed the same shape in its own S/draft_home.sh: a redraft re-charts when a validate berth claims the ticket, and refuses if chain_for_ticket(id)['validate'] does not move. This puts that rule in the shared door.
challenge.real_collision: none: 91a27edfdd81 defined draft as writing the plan only, and that is unchanged when no berth stands.

answers.falsifier: A draft over a standing validate berth (in the berth store or in chart_claim) exits 1 and leaves the plan's bytes unchanged. With nothing standing it drafts as before. --rechart passes only when a new validate berth claims the ticket.
answers.from_idea: none, because this was measured, not imagined: on 8f3d61c0ae47 the only validate berth claiming it stayed berths/chart/validate-20261114T171135-081afd0c1df2.json after commons commit 77a56d84 redrafted only the plan's chart field, and the verdict gate refused twice on the criterion that redraft removed (2026-11-15)
answers.how: sail.py draft reads the standing validate berth by both spellings (chain_for_ticket and chart_claim.validate_berth). If one stands, it writes nothing and names the berth. --rechart drafts, runs chart, and returns 1 unless each standing spelling moved. A red-first proof uses a scratch berth store and a recording bus.
answers.traces_to: Law 4: the verdict reads the claiming berth, never the plan, so a draft-only redraft is a rule (re-chart after redraft) that only policy held. Law 7: the stale berth was a silent wrong answer.
answers.what: A ticket's chart is never redrafted without being re-charted: sail.py draft refuses while a validate berth already stands for the ticket, and its --rechart drafts and charts in one act, then checks the berth moved.

bullets.text: A draft-only redraft left 8f3d's old validate berth in force; sail.py draft now refuses that and --rechart does both in one act.

title: A ticket's chart is never redrafted without being re-charted: sail.py draft refuses while a validate berth already stand
